demos.title: ARP MitM attack (synthetic LAN)
demos.blurb: A small office LAN. A smart plug takes over an IP via DHCP, the printer's NIC is replaced, a MacBook port-scans the NVR, then a Kali VM runs an Ettercap-style ARP poisoning attack.

demos.title: Home network, no attack (synthetic)
demos.blurb: Another day on the same LAN: a new device joins via DHCP and the ISP router is swapped for a backup router with a different MAC. No attack.
